code_snippet: reserved.update(n for n in fs if n.endswith(".py") and n not in ("__init__.py", "conftest.py"))
reasoning_trace: Traced reserved backwards (overlay dests L1081, every fixture .py under a tests/test component L1084-1087) and the candidate walk forwards (L1090-1100: any tree file with a reserved basename not owned, not under an overlay dir, not in the fixture is unlinked). No restriction to pytest-collected names or package-less directories, although the docstring scopes the rule that way. Header L220 says fixtures carry tests/helpers.py.
finding: remove_colliding deletes agent-added implementation modules (e.g. src/pkg/helpers.py) when a fixture tests/helpers.py exists; a correct solution is graded failing with only colliding_tests_removed as trace.
critique: The rule is far broader than the pytest hazard it targets; affects every Sprint 261 calibration row and biases arms that add modules.
remediation: Reserve only test_*.py / *_test.py from both sources; unlink only candidates with no __init__.py sibling under a collected root; add the tests/helpers.py vs src/pkg/helpers.py bats case; flag colliding_tests_removed>0 as degraded.

code_snippet: reserved = {d.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] for d in owned if d.endswith(".py")}
reasoning_trace: The overlay-derived set has no exclusion list; the __init__.py/conftest.py exclusions at L1087 apply only to the fixture walk and L1088 discards only conftest.py. An overlay tests/__init__.py reserves __init__.py tree-wide.
finding: Every agent-created package initializer not in the fixture is unlinked when a hidden overlay ships an __init__.py.
critique: Asymmetric exclusions between the two sources of reserved; trigger depends on task overlays outside this diff.
remediation: Apply one filter to both sources; never reserve __init__.py or conftest.py; add a bats case with an overlay tests/__init__.py and an agent src/newpkg/__init__.py.

code_snippet: owned = {d for _s, d, f in t.overlay if not os.path.isdir(f)}
reasoning_trace: owned excludes directory overlays and reserved derives only from owned; owned_dirs protects contents but never enumerates their test files. load_task (L570-582) accepts a directory source.
finding: Directory overlays contribute nothing to reserved, so the 1.2.11 guard is a no-op for tasks whose hidden tests arrive as a directory; a colliding agent file survives, pytest aborts, colliding_tests_removed stays 0.
critique: Guard behaviour depends on the overlay shape the task author chose.
remediation: os.walk directory overlays and add their collected test-module basenames to reserved; add a directory-overlay bats case.

reasoning_trace: Only tokens.refresh_token is replaced (L633-635); access_token, id_token and OPENAI_API_KEY are written verbatim into $HOME_DIR/.codex/auth.json, bind-mounted rw at /home/evaluser where the evaluated agent runs with network access (L764). The bats case asserts has("OPENAI_API_KEY") with null, so a non-null key is never exercised. Pre-existing surface, narrowed by this change (refresh token removed) but not closed. Companion dissent DISS-C-001 reached the same conclusion.
finding: A live bearer, an OIDC identity token and any long-lived API key remain readable by the agent under evaluation.
critique: The comment frames the change as a credential-safety fix; it closes refresh-token reuse only.
remediation: Write a minimal object (auth_mode, access_token, account_id, placeholder refresh_token); drop id_token; blank/refuse a non-null OPENAI_API_KEY with a WARN; bats case with a non-null key; longer term proxy the codex call from the host.

reasoning_trace: The new cap and reserve-per-trial parameters enter fadd/awk arithmetic without the regex check applied to cost at L130; current callers pass usd_ok-validated values, so this is a library-contract gap. Companion dissent DISS-C-002.

critique: Shared library with other runners per its header.
remediation: Validate cap/per with the cost regex and fall back to RUN_CAP with a log line, or die.
